item.title: Hawai‘i leaders bring film, TV job opportunities back to the state
item.description: Lights, cameras and a fresh wave of productions are rolling across Hawai‘i. Major films and television projects are setting up on Oʻahu and Hawaiʻi Island, and the activity signals new jobs for local crews and renewed energy for the state’s creative economy.

item.title: Local organizations warn to be wary of scams ahead of tax filing
item.description: HONOLULU (KHON2) -- Chances are, almost everybody with a cell phone has received a call claiming a car's extended warranty.
